In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the results of the present investigation indicate that the purified protein derivative of bacillus Calmette-Guerin of 248 children, when tested by the Mantoux technique, was found to be a safe material and that the tuberculin reactions obtained were of a high degree of reliability and validity.
the purified protein derivative of bacillus Calmette-Guerin (PPDBCG) test has a sensitivity of 80-90% and a specificity of about 90% in the diagnosis of tuberculosis infection in children.
the PPD of Bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) is not a reliable diagnostic tool for the evaluation of tuberculosis.
